package.name: easyfleet_mission_manager
package.description: C++ library providing the reusable building blocks for a mission manager: capability discovery (via /capabilities and /capabilities_status), pretty-printing helpers, and a generic run_capability() helper built on easyfleet_core::CapabilityClient. Ships no executables of its own -- see easyfleet_example_deployments for example mission scripts (alone_mission_node, collaboration_mission_node) built on top of this library.
